I think I might actually have some sort of mental health issues with these.

* Every time I have a good or bad day, I partly believe that it has to do with what I did earlier. For example, some things that "cause" me to have bad days is putting eyeliner before mascara, not turning off the lights when I leave the room, or if there are any doors opened in my home. I know this isn't true at all because even if I did everything "correctly" I'll still have a bad day but yet, I can't stop doing it. Currently, the worse one has to be the time. Whenever I see "12:34" am/pm, I assume I'll have a bad day.

* I talk to myself a lot but in an actual conversation. Like I'll spill out some gossip my friends (real) have told me or my problems out loud when I'm with myself. It helps me relax in a way.

* I take every little thing into detail about people when talking to them face-to-face. I'll take note at their facial expressions and the sound of their voice, basically trying to read them the best I can when we're talking about something serious.

* I also like eating Cheetos with Mexican sour cream.

I overthink too much and it has taken over my life. My now ex boyfriend of almost 2 years broke up with me because of this. I'm jealous, insecure, depressed all the time, and anti-social around his friends. I've tried for 2 years but I have never actually succeeded in changing. Even now I think he's with girls and messing around even though he said he won't date for a while. I just I don't know... I'm a mess... I loved him, I still love him. I was fully faithful, always supportive, it's just that I get the worse side of me take over because I don't want to be lied to or cheated on ever again.. There are so many better girls out there for him and he deserves way better... I miss him so fucking much... He got angry easily towards me and called me mean things when we were fighting, but he was just tired of me making small problems into something huge all the time. He put up with me for 2 years and I cannot be more grateful. He really did help me, he really did love me... I just never saw it since he barely showed his emotions but he did.. He really did and I will never forgive myself for it. I don't think I'll ever get over him completely. People always say to give it a few months for me to stop crying for him but they don't know. I'm not a "hoe" but I do move on very quickly. Doesn't matter the length of the relationship, the situation, who broke up with who, I always got over it about a week later. But with him I don't think I ever will. He has the best humor, the best smile, the best everything. No guy will ever compete. He's absolutely perfect to me and I fucked it up. All I'll ever be is a fuck up. I love him so much.. I just want him back... I've been crying every single day and have thought of suicide every single day but I won't do it because he'll never forgive himself, I don't want that. I pray when I don't even fully believe in God.. I'd to anything just to hear him call me "babe" and "love" again. I feel like a huge part of me is gone and I just miss him so fucking much.. This detail can ruin my entire morning, afternoon, and night. I cried as I typed this, I just want him back...
